## A shell where the work is {.i-terminal}

Your login shell, opened in the session's folder, at the chat's
right. Shells are tabs: the **+** or [⌘T]{.kbd} opens one, [⌘W]{.kbd}
closes it, [⌘K]{.kbd} clears the screen, and a drag reorders them. They
stay open until you close them or quit.

Paste a picture and it lands as the path of a file. A selection can copy
itself when you let go (Settings, Terminal). Mouse-aware programs take
clicks and scrolls, and the Mac's line keys work ([⌘←]{.kbd},
[⌘→]{.kbd}, [⌘⌫]{.kbd}). The look is
[Kaku](https://github.com/tw93/kaku)'s, in the window's own colors and
face.

The same shell opens beside the install steps on the Agents page, for
the commands they give. It shares the right side with the
[agent terminal](agent.qmd): one shows at a time.
